description.value:
Ataru turns a duel into a blur, trading measured footing for constant, acrobatic motion. Its practitioners vault, tumble, and dash across the battlefield, using speed and unpredictability to keep opponents perpetually off-balance and unable to pin them down.

A guardian trained in Ataru rarely stands still long enough to be hit, closing distance in a single spring and vanishing again before a counterattack can land, turning raw kinetic energy into an advantage no static fighter can match.
